_comment: Config for the GitHub Actions scan. Deliberately holds no secrets - client_id and client_secret come from the BNET_CLIENT_ID / BNET_CLIENT_SECRET repository secrets, which override this file. Safe to commit; edit it here to change what the hourly scan covers.
_scope: Empty lists = everything in the cached recipe set. The runner scans the lot because it costs four seconds and the published dashboard is nicer for having every expansion in the dropdown.
_addon_path: Empty on purpose. There is no WoW install on a CI runner; --publish writes PriceData.lua into the site directory instead.
_timezone: MUST match the timezone of the machine that runs `pull`. History is one row per day bucketed at LOCAL midnight, so a runner left on UTC keys 16 August as 00:00 UTC while a PC on CEST keys it as 00:00 CEST - the same day stored twice, forever. An IANA name; the workflow exports it as TZ before scanning.
